clause: LAW-12 genesis clause, watch/inbox/BURN_rsi-harness_20260926.md falsifier: one scenario card per G1-G7 minted from real REGISTRY.jsonl FAIL rows within 14 days of registration
citation_provenance: Real fleet FAIL row: the gate run of .zcode/workflows/the-gala.dwf.ts at 2026-09-26T02:32:14Z returned verdict FAIL with G4-salvage as the single fault; the amend at 02:32:43 (digest 0ad57dc88296) shows the single-check repair path. Cited because it is the cleanest one-fault G4 observation in the registry.
scenario_description: Per-item work completes but nothing is published incrementally inside the fan-out (no report(actor) call): if the run dies mid-flight, all completed item work is lost with no salvage trail.
regression_criterion: tools/workflow_gate.py check --scenarios configs/workflow_gate_scenarios exits 0 with this card green. The card goes red if (a) the gate stops flagging fail_g4.dwf.ts (G4 report(x); salvage regex weakened or removed), (b) the fixture starts failing gates beyond expected_verdict.failed_checks, or (c) the cited row disappears from REGISTRY.jsonl. Card and fixture are immutable inputs: a G4 semantics change requires a new dated card filed alongside, never a silent edit.
rollback_note: Scenario mode is read-only: it writes no registry row and touches no file. Rollback of a G4 gate change is a git revert of tools/workflow_gate.py to the pre-change blob, then re-run check --scenarios expecting green. The cited fleet FAIL row (line 5) is history and is never erased; the fixture stays so the reverted gate can be re-proven.
